name: komdosh-dev-spring-quality
description: The audit and QA-artifact suite on top of komdosh-dev-spring-core. 5 agents — security-auditor (route↔SecurityWebFilterChain coverage, RFC 9457 error leakage, JWT/JWK rotation, PII on the data-in-motion surface), platform-developer (vendor-coupling leaks in application/ and domain/, staged into a common/ module), and three QA writers (qa-plan-writer, qa-postman-writer, qa-console-writer) · 7 commands — /qa [plan|postman|console|all] from one shared API-surface discovery, /security-audit plus its four narrowed entry points (/auth-audit, /error-leakage-check, /jwt-rotation, /pii-leakage-check), and /audit-leaks · 4 skills · 2 rules. Read-only on the audit side: never modifies code, never extracts secrets, never prints personal data. Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core.
